formula: I(log(-log(1 - (dead/tot - cm)/(1 - cm)))) ~ ct + (1 + ct | gp), weights from the binomial variances of dead/tot and cm, iterated
notes: Help page: dose-mortality trials of codling moth fumigated with methyl bromide (Maindonald, Waddell and Petry 2001, Postharvest Biology and Technology 22: 99-110); tot is the number of insects in the chamber, dead those dying and pobs their proportion (ignored, derived); gp is 'a factor which has a different level for each different combination of Cultivar, year and rep (replicate)', the replicate series each dose row repeats within; cm and numcm are the series' control mortality and control count, ct the concentration-time sum. No model on the page, in DAAG 3rd ed. or in Maindonald, Braun and Andrews (2024), whose exercise 7.6 fits the companion table sorption by lmer(ct ~ Cultivar + Dose + factor(year) + (-1 + Dose | gp)). Hand check #162: Maindonald, Waddell and Petry (2001, section 2.3.1, Eqs. 1-2) regress y = log(-log(1 - p)), p = (p* - c)/(1 - c) the mortality adjusted for the control mortality cm, on ct with an intercept and a slope per replicate (gp, 11 replicates in 1988 and 6 in 1989), by S-PLUS lme with weights iterated from the binomial variances of the two proportions (Eqs. 3-4); lme also allowed a sequential correlation between neighboring doses. Lines per cultivar (X2 = 12.7, 16 df) and intercepts per year (X2 = 0.45, 1 df) did not improve the fit, so ct is the one covariate and Cultivar, dose and year are ignored; cm and numcm feed the response and the weights. Three points below the control mortality and four outliers were omitted. The response is the expression; dead, its first column, keeps binomial with trials tot. 17 replicates of 5 or 6 doses.

formula: dead ~ dvcat + seatbelt + airbag + frontal + (1 | yearacc:caseid)
notes: Help page: front-seat occupants of US police-reported crashes with a towed vehicle, 1997-2002 (NASS CDS; Meyer and Finney 2005); caseid is 'created by pasting together the populations sampling unit, the case number, and the vehicle number. Within each year, use this to uniquely identify the vehicle', so driver and passenger (occRole) repeat within yearacc:caseid, and the crash (sampling unit and case) has no column of its own. The examples and Maindonald, Braun and Andrews (2024) Chapter 1 tabulate deaths per 1000 by airbag, seatbelt and dvcat (xtabs(weight ~ dvcat + seatbelt + airbag + dead)), with a subset on frontal; no model. weight is the inverse selection probability of the multi-stage sample: the source weights each occupant by it, which the formula leaves out. injSeverity (4 = killed) is an alternate response and deploy codes abcat == 'deploy' (both ignored); dvcat is an ordered factor of estimated impact speed. Hand check #162: stands; 20,670 vehicles, 5,547 of them with two occupants, dead varying within 344. Meyer's analysis (stat.colostate.edu/~meyer/logregres.txt) is a SUDAAN design-based logistic regression, weighted and nested in the sample's strata and PSUs, with no random effect.
